spear_rendering: native hand_equipped item, not a full-length custom 3D mesh
recipe_notifications: native recipe unlock system; not forced when disabled or already unlocked
upgrade_recovery: load-only conversion of old saved rbow_drop inventories; never creates carriers
action_patch: Four conditional native action-animation overrides; exact Rbow item only. No new player, controller, attachment or mesh.
idle_pose: No idle/hold animation override; retain 1.1.5 renderer and sprite.
animation_timing: Client evaluation and use-time query alignment need in-game verification.
known_risks: Normal item first-person rendering may not consume these rightitem bone channels on every client. This patch is a hypothesis to test, not an engine-confirmed repair.
Other resource packs overriding the same four native action-animation identifiers can conflict. No general compatibility claim.
The retained native controller must activate the spear action paths from the item tag. No custom server input polling or extra attack is added.
